jobs.title: Laravel / PHP Developer
jobs.summary: Develop scalable web applications, RESTful APIs, and custom business solutions using Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and modern web technologies.
overview: As a Laravel / PHP Developer at Divaine Tech, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining dynamic web applications and custom software solutions. You will work closely with our development, design, and project teams to transform business requirements into reliable, scalable, and high-performance digital products.

This role is ideal for a passionate developer with strong problem-solving abilities, a solid understanding of backend development, and an interest in building secure and efficient applications using Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and modern development practices.

responsibilities.title: Job Responsibilities
responsibilities.intro: You will contribute to the complete software development lifecycle, from understanding project requirements to developing, testing, and maintaining production-ready applications.
items: Develop, maintain, and optimize web applications using Laravel and Core PHP
Build and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services
Design, manage, and optimize MySQL databases and queries
Develop secure authentication systems, user roles, and permission management
Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well-structured code
Collaborate with frontend developers and UI/UX designers to implement application features
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve application bugs and performance issues
Implement data validation, security best practices, and application optimization
Manage source code using Git and follow version control best practices
Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and ongoing application maintenance

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.intro: We are looking for a motivated PHP developer with practical Laravel experience and a passion for building quality software solutions.
items: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
1–3 years of professional experience in PHP and Laravel development
Strong knowledge of Core PHP, Laravel framework, MVC architecture, and OOP concepts
Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and responsive web design
Hands-on experience with MySQL database design, relationships, and query optimization
Knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, AJAX, and third-party integrations
Familiarity with Git, GitHub, and collaborative development workflows
Understanding of authentication, authorization, security, and application performance
Strong analytical thinking, debugging, and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a development team

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.summary: Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end web applications, backend development, databaseand API integrations to deliver scalable digital solutions.
overview: As a Full Stack Developer at Divaine Tech, you will be responsible for building complete web applications, working across both frontend and backend technologies. You will collaborate with our development, design, and project teams to transform business requirements into responsive, functional, secure, and high-performance digital solutions.

This role is ideal for a versatile developer who enjoys working across the entire development lifecycle, from creating engaging user interfaces to developing robust backend systems, managing databases, integrating APIs, and optimizing application performance.

responsibilities.title: Job Responsibilities
responsibilities.intro: You will contribute to the complete application development process, ensuring seamless integration between frontend interfaces, backend services, and database systems.
items: Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies
Build dynamic user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and modern frontend frameworks
Develop backend applications, business logic, and server-side functionality using PHP and Laravel
Design, manage, and optimize MySQL databases, relationships, and database queries
Develop, integrate, and maintain RESTful APIs and third-party services
Implement secure authentication, authorization, user roles, and permission management
Ensure responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and consistent user experiences
Write clean, reusable, scalable, and well-documented code following development best practices
Identify, debug, and resolve frontend, backend, database, and application performance issues
Collaborate with UI/UX designers, developers, and project managers to deliver project requirements
Use Git and GitHub for version control, code collaboration, and project management
Participate in application testing, deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvements

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.intro: We are looking for a skilled and adaptable developer with a strong understanding of frontend and backend technologies and the ability to build complete web applications.
items: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
1–3 years of professional experience in full stack web development
Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and responsive web design
Hands-on experience with PHP, Laravel framework, MVC architecture, and OOP concepts
Good understanding of MySQL database design, relationships, joins, and query optimization
Experience in developing and integrating RESTful APIs and third-party services
Understanding of AJAX, JSON, frontend-backend communication, and asynchronous operations
Knowledge of authentication, authorization, application security, and data validation
Familiarity with Git, GitHub, and collaborative software development workflows
Understanding of website performance optimization, debugging, and cross-browser compatibility
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and collaborate effectively within a development team

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.summary: Create intuitive, visually engaging, and user-focused digital experiences by designing modern website interfaces, mobile applications, wireframes, prototypes, and interactive design systems.
overview: As a UI/UX Designer at Divaine Tech, you will be responsible for creating engaging, intuitive, and visually appealing digital experiences for websites, mobile applications, and software solutions. You will collaborate closely with developers, project managers, and other creative team members to transform business requirements and user needs into effective design solutions.

This role is ideal for a creative and detail-oriented designer who understands both user experience and visual design principles, enjoys solving design challenges, and is passionate about creating accessible, responsive, and user-friendly digital products.

responsibilities.title: Job Responsibilities
responsibilities.intro: You will lead the design process from initial research and concept development to interactive prototypes and final design handoffs, ensuring a consistent and meaningful user experience.
items: Design modern, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces for websites, mobile applications, and software platforms
Create wireframes, user flows, mockups, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs
Use Figma and other relevant design tools to develop and maintain design concepts
Conduct user research and analyze user requirements to understand customer needs and behavior
Develop intuitive navigation structures and user journeys that improve usability and engagement
Create and maintain consistent design systems, reusable components, typography, and color guidelines
Apply UI/UX best practices to ensure accessibility, usability, and responsive design across devices
Collaborate with frontend developers to ensure accurate implementation of approved designs
Review implemented interfaces and provide design feedback to maintain visual and functional consistency
Stay updated with emerging design trends, modern interface patterns, and industry best practices
Collect feedback, identify usability issues, and continuously improve existing designs
Prepare design specifications and assets for smooth developer handoff

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.intro: We are looking for a creative UI/UX Designer with a strong visual sense, an understanding of user-centered design, and the ability to turn ideas into practical digital experiences.
items: Bachelor's degree in Design, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
1–3 years of professional experience in UI/UX or digital product design
Strong hands-on experience with Figma and familiarity with other design tools
Good understanding of UI design principles, UX methodologies, typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy
Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and high-fidelity interface designs
Understanding of responsive web design and mobile-first design principles
Knowledge of usability, accessibility, interaction design, and user-centered design practices
Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap is an added advantage
Ability to create consistent design systems and reusable UI components
A strong portfolio showcasing website, mobile application, or digital product design projects
Excellent attention to detail, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams

jobs.title: Game Developer
jobs.summary: Design, develop, and optimize engaging interactive gaming experiences using modern game development technologies, programming languages, and creative gameplay mechanics.
overview: As a Game Developer at Divaine Tech, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing engaging gaming experiences across different platforms. You will work closely with designers, artists, developers, and project teams to transform creative concepts into interactive, visually appealing, and high-performance games.

This role is ideal for a passionate developer with strong programming skills, creative thinking, and an interest in game mechanics, interactive environments, and real-time experiences. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the complete game development lifecycle, from initial concepts and prototyping to testing, optimization, and deployment.

responsibilities.title: Job Responsibilities
responsibilities.intro: You will contribute to the complete game development lifecycle, building interactive gameplay systems, implementing features, and ensuring smooth performance across supported platforms.
items: Design, develop, and implement interactive gameplay features and game mechanics
Develop games using game engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using C#, C++, or other relevant programming languages
Build and integrate game systems, character controls, animations, physics, and user interfaces
Collaborate with game designers, 2D/3D artists, and other developers to bring creative concepts to life
Implement audio, visual effects, interactive environments, and gameplay elements
Integrate APIs, third-party SDKs, multiplayer functionality, and external game services where required
Optimize game performance, loading times, memory usage, and resource management
Identify, debug, and resolve technical issues, gameplay bugs, and compatibility problems
Conduct gameplay testing and improve overall user experience, stability, and responsiveness
Maintain code quality and manage development workflows using Git and version control systems
Research emerging gaming technologies, tools, and development techniques to improve game experiences

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.intro: We are looking for a creative and technically skilled Game Developer with a passion for interactive entertainment and the ability to turn innovative ideas into engaging gaming experiences.
items: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Game Development, or a related field
1–3 years of professional experience in game development or interactive application development
Hands-on experience with Unity or Unreal Engine
Good programming knowledge of C#, C++, or other game development languages
Understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and software development fundamentals
Knowledge of game mechanics, gameplay systems, physics, animations, and user interface implementation
Understanding of 2D and 3D game development concepts and real-time rendering fundamentals
Familiarity with asset integration, scene management, and game optimization techniques
Knowledge of debugging, testing, performance profiling, and cross-platform compatibility
Familiarity with Git, GitHub, and collaborative development workflows
Creative problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a passion for gaming
Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a development team
